title: AIUC-1 Readiness Checkrun
description: CHECKRUN definition covering the 23 automatable AIUC-1 controls (pillars A-F, 2026-Q1 taxonomy). Each control is one step; attach an attestation note or a sha256 evidence digest, then produce a hash-chained, Merkle-rooted readiness bundle prepared for AIUC-1 review. Not an AIUC-1 certification.

control_evidence.description: Per-control attestation notes or sha256 evidence digests, keyed by AIUC-1 control_id

readiness_bundle.description: definition, definition_digest, run_receipt (Merkle root over 23 step receipts), step_receipts, coverage_summary

mcp_tool_definition.name: run_aiuc1_readiness_checkrun
mcp_tool_definition.description: Runs the 23-step AIUC-1 automatable-control CHECKRUN (pillars A-F, 2026-Q1) and produces a hash-chained, Merkle-rooted readiness bundle prepared for AIUC-1 review.

control_evidence.description: Per-control attestation notes or sha256 evidence digests
